OTHER PRESENT:
 SRI G.SUDHEER (PP)
 THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 19.10.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.MC No.6844 of 2023  3  ORDER
The petitioners face prosecution under Sections 406 and 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
A crime was registered against the petitioners as Crime No.459 of 2022 of Pantheerankavu Police Station, Palakkad, alleging commission of offences under the aforesaid provisions of law.
The matter is now pending as C.C.No.784 of 2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-III, Kozhikode.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-III, Kozhikode
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the entire disputes between the petitioners and the defacto complainant (third respondent) have been settled, as is evident from Annexure A-3 affidavit executed by the third respondent/defacto complainant.

It is submitted that no useful purpose would be served in continuing with the prosecution against the petitioners in the light of the settlement of all issues between the petitioners and the third respondent/defacto complainant.

3. The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, would submit that the disputes between the petitioners and the third respondent have been settled and the third respondent does not wish to continue with the prosecution against the petitioners.

4. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor and having regard to the contents of Annexure A-3 affidavit executed by the third respondent/defacto complainant and also having regard to the statement of the learned Public Prosecutor that the issues between the petitioners and the third respondent have been settled, I am of the view that this is a fit case where, a jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. can be invoked to quash the Muhammed Samil vs State Of Kerala on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109035042/
2 proceedings against the petitioners.
Accordingly, this Crl.M.C. is allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.784 of 2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-III, Kozhikode will stand quashed.
Sd/-
